items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: So the fella told Benny Morris about it, Benny Morris caught me on Burberry Street. He said, what's the matter with that man named Flayne?

ctx.x: Somebody said, that boy's got talent, so he got him a- Oh, I had him a- Oh, he grew on a bit right fast, man. Yeah, the trombone was getting out of the street. Russell's taking all of his time. He's incriminating the statements over there. He's making notes. I'm missing it. He's just incredible. Wow. Right in there.
